harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured LDAP field-level privacy on node1 and verified access remotely from node2. Demonstration credentials are stored root-only at /srv/legacy2/ldap-attribute-privacy/demo-credentials.env on node1 and /root/hr-directory-demo on node2. Both nodes retained Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic and recovered successfully from sequential restarts.
actions_performed: Loaded the supplied Morgan Lake employee record while preserving the original LDIF.
Created dedicated directory-reader and hr-admin identities.
Configured ACLs so the reader sees names and mail but not employeeNumber; anonymous users see no employee records.
Verified reader writes fail and administrator writes succeed, restoring employeeNumber to HR-4815 afterward.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovered functionality.

evidence.requirement: Supplied records retained and loaded on node1
evidence.summary: LDAP entry was loaded; original LDIF remains present with its checksum, and the database contains the supplied employee values.

evidence.requirement: Reader can search names and mail from node2 but cannot read employeeNumber
evidence.summary: Remote reader searches return Morgan Lake and morgan@hr.test without employeeNumber, including after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: Only HR administrator may read or change employeeNumber
evidence.summary: Administrator reads the attribute; reader modification fails with LDAP error 50; administrator modification succeeds and the original HR-4815 value is restored. Final ACL configuration confirms the restriction.

evidence.requirement: Anonymous users see no employee records
evidence.summary: Anonymous employee searches return no entries before and after restarts.
Protected credential files exist on both nodes with root-only permissions; passwords were not exposed in evidence.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes report Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic after completion.

Healthy baseline boot c6b4840c-4762-4aca-bd5e-ce97ac0c4344, safe restart acknowledgement, changed boot a6c7aed9-5991-421d-bd2b-5259db8399b1, and recovered slapd, LDIF, reader privacy, and administrator data.

Healthy baseline boot 79199c3c-ebee-4210-bdb3-ed8eec67068a, safe restart acknowledgement, changed boot 0caeff16-ac0f-4e79-8334-11ec9493e68b, and recovered credentials, LDAP client, remote reader/admin access, and anonymous denial.
